ul.li: When the product name changes (e.g., from “Product Line A” to “Platinum Edition”), you only update the <keydef> once, and all maps that use keyref="product-name" automatically reflect the change.
If the release‑notes topic is renamed or moved, you change the href in the key definition, not in every individual map or topic.
